verdicts.reason: The new 1,380-line global stylesheet mixes plans and help selectors with workbench rules and places their responsive overrides in shared media blocks, so extracting those page-specific rules would make future page edits and cascade review materially more local, as the existing history.css arrangement demonstrates.

The plan import callback resumes after await f.text() with its pre-read plans closure, while deletion and saving remain available and persist newer state, so its later persist([...fresh, ...plans]) can restore a deleted plan or discard a newer save.

History import awaits f.text() without a generation check, while Restore demo and another file selection can update all/source/notice during that wait, allowing the older read to finish last and overwrite the user's newer choice.
